data class [ContentInput](index.html) @[JvmOverloads](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin.jvm/-jvm-overloads/index.html) constructor(val content: [Content](../../com.google.adk.kt.types/-content/index.html), val partial: [Boolean](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-boolean/index.html) = false) : [LiveInput](../-live-input/index.html)

A user turn, or the function responses that answer the model's calls.

The constructor throws [IllegalArgumentException](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-illegal-argument-exception/index.html) unless [content](../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.models/-content-input/--root--.html) has at least one part, carries no function calls, and holds either only function responses or none of them.
